```{r}
## UI Code Here
choices <- c("species", "island")   
selectInput("variable", "Select Variable to color by", choices)

```


```{r}
plotOutput("my_plot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
#thematic::thematic_shiny(bg = "#F9F9F9", fg = "#1A1A1A", accent="#FFFFFF")
thematic::thematic_shiny(inherit = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(palmerpenguins)
output$my_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(input$variable)
  
  ggplot(penguins) +
    aes(x=bill_length_mm, 
        y=bill_depth_mm, 
        color= .data[[input$variable]] ) +
      geom_point() +
    theme_minimal()
})
```
